title: Council hopes use of reusable containers continues after Ramadan | The Star
text: Council hopes use of reusable containers continues after Ramadan | The Star × View Community Council hopes use of reusable containers continues after Ramadan By YVONNE T. NATHAN Tuesday, 14 Jun 2016 | 12:00 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Singapore 26 Sep 2026 Air quality in Singapore's central region back in unhealthy range; 24-hour PSI reading at 108 Singapore 1d ago Haze in Singapore: Air quality in all five regions unhealthy, PM2.5 readings elevated across island Singapore 19 Sep 2026 Haze in Singapore: PSI in central region back in the unhealthy range MPAJ’s Sustainable Bazaar Programme 2016 at Pandan Indah’s Ramadan bazaar emphasises use of biodegradable or reusable containers instead of polystyrene. Ampang Jaya Municipal Council (MPAJ) has joined other local councils to discourage the use of polystyrene and plastics, by launching its Sustainable Bazaar Programme 2016. Selangor Housing Committee chairman Datuk Iskandar Abdul Samad said the state government was looking at implementing a ban on polystyrene and plastics in favour of reusable and biodegradable containers.
